capability: Remove drift between the canonical stable-release-note prose and the existing executable renderer without expanding automatic validation claims
searchEvidence: scripts/render_release_notes.py is the existing executable workflow owner for exact release-note extraction and requires Summary, Product changes, Security, Known issues, Upgrade and rollback, and Downloads and integrity in that order.

The branch/version/release governance prose still names an older Feature changes, Fixes, and Performance and package layout, creating two conflicting six-section contracts even though the protected workflow always calls the renderer.

The renderer provides structural and limited lexical validation only: it cannot establish implementation truth, evidence sufficiency, compatibility accuracy, support status, completeness of limitations, or general private-path safety.
Existing tests already bind the executable headings and per-feature fields. Aligning prose to those established names requires no script, workflow, schema, package, or runtime change.

terminalContract: The canonical prose uses the renderer's exact ordered headings: Summary, Product changes, Security, Known issues, Upgrade and rollback, and Downloads and integrity.
